review: Room was spacious with floor to ceiling windows and a great view of Gardens by the Bay.
Check in queue was over an hour long, terrible for such an expensive hotel.
The room felt a bit tired and dated, the carpet had stains.
The infinity pool on the 57th floor is unreal, the view of the skyline is worth the trip.
Very expensive, you are paying for the pool and the name more than the room.
Location is excellent, the mall, casino and the light show are right downstairs.
The pool was so crowded with people taking selfies that we could barely swim.
Staff at the concierge were helpful with restaurant bookings.
The bed was very comfortable and the blackout curtains were perfect after a long flight.
Breakfast buffet was crowded and the food was average for the price.
Watching the sunset from the rooftop was the highlight of our holiday.
The lifts were always packed and we waited ages to get to our floor.
The bathroom was clean but the water pressure was weak.
The view from our room at night was spectacular, the city looks magical.
Housekeeping kept the room spotless every day.
Room service was slow and very pricey.
